name: youtube
description: Summary, chapters, and transcript of a YouTube video, a search, a playlist, or a channel. Falls back to speech recognition when a video has no captions. Optional notes on what appears on screen.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: Digest of one video URL, with the path of its saved transcript inside. Makes one paid model call unless the digest is cached, and one more with --visual.

input.description: Video URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

visual.description: Also download the video, pick key frames, and describe them with the see atom, a paid model call. The digest then has a visual field.

verbs.name: transcript
verbs.description: Transcript of one video URL. Makes no model call.

input.description: Video URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

verbs.name: search
verbs.description: Digests of the videos that search words, a YouTube playlist, or a channel resolve to, plus the videos that failed. Makes one paid model call per video unless its digest is cached.

input.description: Search words, or a YouTube playlist or channel URL.

limit.description: How many search results to take, 1 by default. For a playlist or channel, stop after this many videos.

visual.description: Also download each video, pick key frames, and describe them with the see atom, a paid model call. Each digest then has a visual field.
